{"sourceType":"ESO Legacy >=150 kEUR Historical","sourceAuthority":"European Southern Observatory","authority":"European Southern Observatory (ESO)","reference":"256","title":"Service Contract for the Testing of VLT/ELT and ALMA Dataflow Software.","description":"Division: DOE/DOO. The scope of this Call for Tender is to outsource software testing services for the VLT/ELT/ALMA dataflow software. The scope of the work is the software testing of science operations dataflow applications for the ESO Observatories VLT/ELT/ALMA within a service contract. Specifically, the scope of the work is for dataflow applications related to Program Preparation, Program Selection, Observation Preparation, Operations Support and Science Archive. The contract will be structured around defined testing services using an agile process with roughly one to two months iteration cycles. At the end of each cycle the testing service for the next cycle will be agreed. The technical focus of this service contract is on testing Java and web-based applications for the VLT/ELT and ALMA dataflow systems. The contractor should have as a minimum the following experience/capabilities: · Familiarity with Agile software development process · Solid practical familiarity with modern software engineering practices and tools, including configuration control tools, incremental & iterative development, unit and integration testing and the Linux environment · Demonstrated experience with configuration management tools, preferably SVN and Git · Demonstrated experience with issue management systems, and continuous integration systems (e.g. Jenkins) · Proven experience of Unit test frameworks like Junit or TestNG · Very good knowledge of testing REST API applications · Good knowledge of Java software development · Good knowledge of testing dynamic web applications, including Javascript-centric single page applications (e.g. Angular applications) · Good experience in testing tools like Selenium · Significant experience with relational databases and SQL · Good knowledge of test automation · Good knowledge of testing Java Desktop GUIs under Linux and/or MacOS · Good knowledge of scripting languages, preferably Groovy and/or Python The contract is foreseen to have an initial duration of three years, with an option for an extension of up to two years.
